_comment: Windows PowerShell 5.1 compatibility baseline for the Weekly Maintenance compatibility matrix. Until 2026-09-07 that job ran `shell: pwsh` (PowerShell 7), so the 5.1 compatibility claim had never been tested. This is the FIRST measurement under a real 5.1 host. It is a regression gate, not a pass mark: CI fails if FailedCount rises above this number, and also fails if it drops below it without this file being updated, so the baseline cannot silently go stale.
Notes: 42 failed containers means those test FILES could not even load under 5.1 -- most likely PowerShell 7-only syntax (ternary, null-coalescing, pipeline chain operators) or #Requires -Version 7.
Reducing this number is tracked work, not a CI fix. Lower the baseline as files are made 5.1-clean.
The same suite under PowerShell 7 has a much smaller failure count; see commit 15f999a for that separate, pre-existing test-contract debt.
